notes.title: Game Beta Release
notes.content:
I'm very happy to annouce that Isolate ME finally are in working condition, thanks everyone for supporting me making this game.

So, as we are now in beta release, I can introduce you a lot of bug fixes and finally I made a game saving system and level changings.

  The game will save your progress when you complete each level, after that you can exit game and continue whenever you want [b]BUT[/b] if you will lose game and not replay it, your progress will be losed.

  Also I have refreshed a game look to be more nice and neat :) Hope you will enjoy this game!

Best regards, Leon

notes.title: Big Update 0.1.3
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, dear players! [/h1]
I'm so happy to announce first Big and very important update.
From this point I will make several updates to add new skills, mechanics and thinking about quests, so stay tuned for next updates ;)
